pages.lesson:
LESSON: SHARIAH RELIGION INTELLECT LIFE PROPERTY DIGNITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Shariah religion intellect life property dignity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Shariah religion intellect life property dignity. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the objective of Maqasid Shariah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims
2. describe the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah as a means of upholding divine guidance

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah as a means of upholding divine guidance
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah as a means of upholding divine guidance. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Shariah religion intellect life property dignity using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Shariah religion intellect life property dignity in the examples.
2. Explain Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
4. Show that you can: explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Shariah religion intellect life property dignity using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Shariah religion intellect life property dignity important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the relevance of Islamic Shariah in the modern world and make a class presentation,
2. Communication and Collaboration: listening and speaking skills is enhanced as learners discuss the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah in pairs and make a class presentation.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the objective of Maqasid Shariah?
2. How do legal acts guide Muslims?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims
2. describe the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah as a means of upholding divine guidance

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
